resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (DFT code, LDA functional, DFT-D2 vdW correction)

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT package; use LDA exchange-correlation and DFT-D2 van der Waals correction.
Recommended pseudopotentials for H, O, Hf, Mo, S from the SSSP efficiency library; PBE or PBEsol pseudopotentials acceptable as LDA-specific ones may not exist.

access.accession: Crystallography Open Database COD ID 1000014 or ICSD 42542
access.notes: Bulk MoS2 hexagonal structure (space group P6_3/mmc); monolayer obtained by isolating a single layer.

resources.name: Crystal structure of bulk monoclinic HfO2

access.accession: ICSD 63861 or equivalent monoclinic HfO2 structure (P2_1/c)
access.notes: Monoclinic HfO2 slab ~2 nm thick cut from bulk with appropriate surface orientation.

resources.name: Standard DFT parameters (cutoff, k-mesh, force convergence)

access.notes: Plane-wave cutoff 400 eV, 7x7x1 k-point mesh for relaxations, force convergence 0.02 eV/Å; these are implementation choices the agent may adjust for convergence.

resources.notes: Not a downloadable resource; parameters used to guide DFT convergence.
